crossRefs.note: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will…
The righteous perish, and no one lays it to heart. Merciful men are taken away, and no one considers that the righteous…
He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

translations.web: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
translations.bsb: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.
translations.kjv: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
translations.asv: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, Neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
